primary_source.title: SAGE: Multi-Agent Self-Evolution for LLM Reasoning

verified_claims: The paper instantiates four roles from a shared backbone: Challenger, Planner, Solver and Critic. Solver correctness is determined by an external domain verifier V_gt; the Critic scores question/plan quality and format but is not the ground-truth correctness oracle.
The reported Qwen-2.5-7B gains include +8.9% on LiveCodeBench and +10.7% on OlympiadBench, as stated in the abstract/main results.

Contrary to the worker's statement that component-level ablations were not established in that invocation, the paper does include Qwen-2.5-3B training ablations for Challenger, Solver and Critic. Full SAGE has O Avg 42.0; w/o challenger training 39.5; w/o solver training 38.2; w/o critic training 40.4. LiveCodeBench is 16.9 full versus 9.0 without Challenger or Solver training and 14.1 without Critic training.

Table 3 contains no 'w/o planner training' row, even though Algorithm 1 explicitly updates pi_c, pi_p, pi_s and pi_cr and Section 4.3 defines a Planner training reward. Therefore the paper does not provide a matched Planner-removal effect in that table, and its prose 'removing any single agent' is broader than the rows actually shown.

The external verifier is central to the loop: generated candidate tasks are checked for verifier validity, Challenger difficulty uses Solver outcomes under V_gt, and Solver correctness reward includes V_gt. No verifier-removal ablation was located in the inspected ablation table, so the headline gains cannot be attributed to self-judging alone.

Training dynamics are not monotone. On Qwen-2.5-3B validation rises from 29.1% to 65.8% by step 80, peaks at 69.5% around steps 100-140, then declines to 61.6% by step 240 while the valid-question pool continues growing from 1,136 to 20,532 by step 250. The authors therefore report main results around step 100 and explicitly cite possible over-specialization on the self-generated curriculum.
scope_corrections: Update the worker's 'component-level ablations not established' statement: Challenger, Solver and Critic training ablations are in the primary paper. Planner training and external-verifier removal are not isolated by Table 3.

Do not claim four-agent optimality or that every one of the four roles has an individually demonstrated causal contribution. The paper's Table 3 omits a Planner-removal row despite the four-role joint-update algorithm.
Do not treat the Critic as the final correctness judge. External domain verification is the correctness signal; Critic quality scores are a separate filtering/gating layer.

Do not describe the self-evolution trajectory as indefinitely stable or monotonically improving. The paper itself reports post-peak validation decline despite continued curriculum growth and selects an earlier checkpoint for main reporting.

The individual ablations change whether a role is trained while keeping the rest of the framework active; they do not prove that the architectural presence/absence of the role, compute allocation, or verifier interactions are isolated under a fully matched counterfactual.
interpretation: SAGE is useful positive evidence that a differentiated multi-agent curriculum/planning/solving/filtering loop with external verification can improve reasoning from a small seed set. The stronger claim that all four roles are individually necessary is not established by the reported component table. The paper also supplies its own negative-control signal: curriculum volume can keep increasing after validation performance peaks and declines, so an optimizer should track held-out quality rather than raw synthetic-data yield.
downstream_use: Represent SAGE as full-system positive evidence plus partial component evidence. Preserve external verifier dependence and checkpoint-selection/over-specialization as first-class qualifiers. For any O adaptation, require a held-out stopping/control signal and do not optimize synthetic-question throughput as a standalone objective.
scope_guard: Primary-paper verification only; no official training artifact or raw trajectory was independently replayed in this invocation.
exact_next_action: Rotate out of multi_agent. Open the exact sealed C15 continual_learning or evaluation artifact and prioritize a claim whose quantitative result can be independently recomputed from public code/raw data or whose provenance can be mechanically falsified.
